title: Rebirth active School Hohenwestedt
summary: As part of the project, the “Rebirth Active School” prevention programme is implemented in everyday school life. The aim is to find out how well the programme is accepted by pupils and teachers and to gain experience with its implementation in the school setting. In addition, the physical activity of pupils who voluntarily take part in the data collection is measured using an activity tracker. An online questionnaire is used to collect information on physical activity, health-related quality of life, dietary habits and media use. The project initially targets pupils in Year 2 of primary school and Years 5 and 8 of secondary school. Teachers are also asked about their experiences and views regarding the acceptance and implementation of the prevention programme.
conditions: The participants are pupils in Years 2, 5 and 8 of all genders (female/diverse/male). Teachers from Years 2, 5 and 8 are also taking part.

interventions.name: Implementation of a prevention programme to promote physical activity in everyday school life and evaluation of the programme’s acceptance among pupils and teachers using questionnaires. Inclusion criteria:
Pupils in Years 2, 5 and 8 who have provided written informed consent, with additional written informed consent from their legal guardians, for participation in the measurements and questionnaires; teachers who have provided written informed consent.
Exclusion criteria:
No written informed consent for data collection.
